notes.title: Update V1.1.3 bug fix
notes.content:
Some people were affected by a bug that caused Chroma Lab to use up all of their computers memory (RAM) causing it to crash or run really slowly.

It was most likely caused by a recent SteamVR update breaking my adaptive resolution/quality implementation in Chroma Lab.

I have updated Chroma Lab to disable adaptive resolution which appears to have fixed the issue.  
The down side is there may be a small loss in image quality/sharpness and you may occasionally have more dropped frames.  The differences should be very small and likely not noticable.

I have also re-enabled the interactive walls during gameplay as I had accidentally disabled them during the previous update.

notes.title: Update v1.1.0
notes.content:
It is long overdue but here is a small update to Chroma Lab

Changes:
[list]
 [*]Increased the maximum particle count from 1 million to 2 million (for those who want to really push their Nvidia Titan V)
 [*]Added a new particle shader and color palette
 [*]Updated MixCast to v2.0
 [*]A few other small changes/improvements
[/list]

notes.title: Release!!!
notes.content:
Almost a year after first starting it, I am proud to finally release Chroma Lab!

Thanks to all the beta testers who kept making me make it better!

Here is the trailer in higher quality, 60fps.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=027kIfxjnA4


Thank you for reading this and if you buy it, extra thanks!
